get.description:
Lists posts from a Bluesky profile by handle. Results are paged: while `data.page.hasMore` is true, send `data.page.nextCursor` as `cursor` to get the next page.

> **Request example pending verification.** The request example for this endpoint has not yet been verified in production. Static examples describe the request format; replace sample values with your own. Check the estimated price with a free quote request (`X-AISA-Cost-Mode: quote`) before running it.

schema.description: Bluesky handle whose posts should be listed.
Pagination cursor returned by a previous response.
Optional Bluesky user id to speed up the request.

aisa_pagination.description: AIsa pagination. Pass next_cursor as cursor to fetch the next page; has_more is false on the last page.

200.description: Observed successful JSON response. This partial structure comes from successful probe or sampled requests; fields and types may vary. No field is guaranteed to be present. Last observed: 2026-11-14.

X-AISA-Next-Cursor.description: Mirrors aisa_pagination.next_cursor; absent on the last page.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats
